title: Empire of Pain
author: Patrick Radden Keefe
summary: Patrick Radden Keefe traces three generations of the Sackler family, from the immigrant brothers who built a fortune to the company that sold OxyContin. He shows how the drug fed the opioid epidemic.
readIf: you like long investigative nonfiction about money, power and corporate responsibility.
skipIf: you want a short read or find stories of institutional wrongdoing too bleak.
